steps.line: * Then the View menu holds Fold Heading, Unfold Heading, Fold All and Unfold All

expect.why: the View menu holds Fold Heading
the View menu holds Unfold Heading
the View menu holds Fold All
the View menu holds Unfold All

steps.line: * And none of them has a key equivalent

expect.that: [.menus.items[] | select(.path == "View > Fold Heading")] | length > 0 and all(.key == "-")
expect.why: Fold Heading has no key equivalent

expect.that: [.menus.items[] | select(.path == "View > Unfold Heading")] | length > 0 and all(.key == "-")
expect.why: Unfold Heading has no key equivalent

expect.that: [.menus.items[] | select(.path == "View > Fold All")] | length > 0 and all(.key == "-")
expect.why: Fold All has no key equivalent

expect.that: [.menus.items[] | select(.path == "View > Unfold All")] | length > 0 and all(.key == "-")
expect.why: Unfold All has no key equivalent
